summary: Larger channels exist, but only Planning Center's free self-serve integrations directory (78,000+ churches vendor-stated, directory reach unproven) is actionable now for a one- or two-person team, and it is an on-ramp rather than a demonstrated audience. RightNow Media (~20,000 paying churches, not the 30,000+ it advertises) is the best requires-leverage candidate with no public vendor path; the paid channels (Lifeway, TGC, Christianity Today) are real but every headline number counts a looser unit than it sounds and none publishes a price.
